---
title: "Simulation Scenario B"
output: html_document
---

## Libraries

```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(scales)

root_dir <- if (dir.exists("TA_functions")) "." else if (dir.exists("../TA_functions")) ".." else "../.."
simulation_dir <- if (dir.exists("Simulation_Scenario_B")) "Simulation_Scenario_B" else ".."
data_dir <- file.path(simulation_dir, "data")
image_dir <- file.path(simulation_dir, "images")
results_dir <- file.path(simulation_dir, "results")

source(file.path(root_dir, "TA_functions", "TA_functions.R"))

dir.create(image_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Configuration

```{r configuration}
analysis_target_label <- "ARIMA Forecast Error"
lift_metric <- "rmse"
n_rules <- 3
training_end <- as.Date("2021-12-31")
test_start <- as.Date("2022-01-01")

# Week is week of month: 1--5.
final_formula <- .resid ~ Day + Week + Month

param_grid <- expand.grid(
  cp = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.005, 0.01),
  minbucket = seq(4, 8, by = 1),
  maxdepth = seq(4, 8, by = 1),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

## Load Simulation Data

```{r prepare-data}
analysis_data <- read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "scenario_b_actual_forecast_series.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = as.Date(Time),
    Day = day(Time),
    Week = ceiling(day(Time) / 7),
    Month = month(Time)
  ) %>%
  select(Time, Value, .fitted, .resid, Day, Week, Month)

train_set <- analysis_data %>% filter(Time <= training_end, is.finite(.resid))
test_set <- analysis_data %>% filter(Time >= test_start, is.finite(.resid))
```

## Grid Search

```{r grid-search}
grid_search <- tree_alert_grid_search(
  train_set = train_set,
  formula = final_formula,
  param_grid = param_grid,
  n_groups = 20,
  pred_col_name = "Tree_Prediction",
  lift_metric = lift_metric
)
best_params <- grid_search$best_params

cat("Best parameters\n")
print(best_params)
```

## Final Model and Lift

```{r final-model}
best_tree_model <- tree_alert_train_best_model(
  train_set = train_set,
  formula = final_formula,
  best_params = best_params
)

train_set$Tree_Prediction <- as.numeric(predict(best_tree_model, newdata = train_set, type = "vector"))
test_set$Tree_Prediction <- as.numeric(predict(best_tree_model, newdata = test_set, type = "vector"))
analysis_data <- bind_rows(train_set, test_set) %>% arrange(Time)

train_lift <- tree_alert_compute_lift_numeric(train_set, ".resid", "Tree_Prediction", 20, lift_metric)
test_lift <- tree_alert_compute_lift_numeric(test_set, ".resid", "Tree_Prediction", 20, lift_metric)

tree_rules <- rpart.plot::rpart.rules(best_tree_model, cover = FALSE, digits = 4, nn = FALSE)
rule_selection <- tree_alert_pull_top_k_rules(tree_rules, n_rules = n_rules)
selected_rules <- rule_selection$selected_rules
selected_rule_values <- rule_selection$selected_rule_values
raw_rules <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(selected_rules)),
  function(i) tree_alert_format_rule_raw(selected_rules[i, ]),
  character(1)
)

cat("\nFirst-ventile RMSE lift\n")
cat("Training:", round(train_lift, 3), "\n")
cat("Test:    ", round(test_lift, 3), "\n")
```

## Top Rules

```{r top-rules}
rule_output <- tibble(
  rule = seq_along(raw_rules),
  raw_rule = raw_rules
)
print(rule_output)
```

## Rule Coverage and Overlays

```{r rule-plots, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
rule_points <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(selected_rule_values), function(i) {
  analysis_data %>%
    filter(round(Tree_Prediction, 4) == round(as.numeric(selected_rule_values[i]), 4)) %>%
    mutate(Rule = paste("Rule", i))
})) %>%
  mutate(Rule = factor(Rule, levels = paste("Rule", seq_along(selected_rule_values))))

rule_coverage <- rule_points %>%
  group_by(Rule) %>%
  summarise(
    train_points = sum(Time <= training_end),
    test_points = sum(Time >= test_start),
    total_points = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(rule_coverage)

rule_colors <- c("Rule 1" = "#B2182B", "Rule 2" = "#2166AC", "Rule 3" = "#1B7837")
base_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98),
    legend.justification = c("left", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.9), color = "grey70")
  )

actual_fitted_plot <- ggplot(analysis_data, aes(x = Time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Value, color = "Actual"), linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_line(aes(y = .fitted, color = "ARIMA fitted / forecast"), linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(data = rule_points, aes(y = Value, color = Rule),
             shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 1.8, stroke = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = test_start, linetype = "dashed", color = "#333333") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "#4C78A8", "ARIMA fitted / forecast" = "#E17C05", rule_colors)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Daily demand", color = NULL) +
  base_theme

residual_plot <- ggplot(analysis_data, aes(x = Time, y = .resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#333333", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_line(color = "#4C78A8", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(data = rule_points, aes(color = Rule),
             shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 1.8, stroke = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = test_start, linetype = "dashed", color = "#333333") +
  scale_color_manual(values = rule_colors) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = analysis_target_label, color = NULL) +
  base_theme

grid.arrange(actual_fitted_plot, residual_plot, ncol = 1)

ggsave(file.path(image_dir, "scenario_b_tuning_actual_fitted_rules.png"),
       actual_fitted_plot, width = 11, height = 5.5, dpi = 1000)
ggsave(file.path(image_dir, "scenario_b_tuning_error_rules.png"),
       residual_plot, width = 11, height = 4.7, dpi = 1000)
```

## Save Tuning Results

```{r save-results}
summary_output <- tibble(
  setting = c("Predictors", "Rules retained", "Lift metric", "Best cp", "Best minbucket", "Best maxdepth", "Training first-ventile lift", "Test first-ventile lift"),
  value = c(
    "Day, week of month, Month",
    as.character(n_rules),
    "RMSE",
    format(best_params$cp, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
    as.character(best_params$minbucket),
    as.character(best_params$maxdepth),
    sprintf("%.3f", train_lift),
    sprintf("%.3f", test_lift)
  )
)

write_csv(summary_output, file.path(results_dir, "scenario_b_tuning_summary.csv"))
write_csv(rule_output, file.path(results_dir, "scenario_b_tuning_rules.csv"))
write_csv(rule_coverage, file.path(results_dir, "scenario_b_tuning_rule_coverage.csv"))
write_csv(grid_search$results, file.path(results_dir, "scenario_b_tuning_grid_search.csv"))
saveRDS(best_tree_model, file.path(results_dir, "scenario_b_tuning_tree_model.rds"))
```
